_comment: THE state table (assets/brand/BRAND.md section 4 and 8). Seven words, one Unicode glyph and one 7-bit mark each, the one-row raven where a state has one, and the 16-colour slot (SGR number) and console colour it prints in. Every renderer reads this through a GENERATED reader: server/lib/state-table.sh (bash), state-table.py (python), state-table.js (node, plus the copy appd deploys as server/appd/lib/state-table.js). Edit here, then run: node scripts/gen-state-table.js. The 7-bit mark is what anything that can reach Windows PowerShell 5.1 prints; the glyph is for titles, tmux and Telegram. A mark means one thing everywhere.
